searchText: For eth.limo, we're talking about it internally a fair bit. Trying to figure out what endpoints should actually be exposed to the public ingress. Do we run a light server? Do we just provide beacon chain block headers as an honest peer for optimistic sync? Does anyone own a good ens name for publishing Alt-Svc redirects to where browser light clients can go to find peers?
